content: My order hasn't arrived, it's been 6 days

Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out to ShopEase Support. I'm sorry to hear that your order hasn't arrived yet. Standard delivery typically takes 3-5 business days, but sometimes there can be delays due to various reasons.

To help resolve this issue, could you please provide me with your order number? Once I have that, I will be able to track the status of your order and update you accordingly. If we find any discrepancies or delays, I will escalate your case to a human agent for further assistance.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Best regards,
Nena
ShopEase Support
